source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-32), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Introduction to Software Development) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Software development is a systematic process that transforms ______ into software products.
(Software development aik munazzam (systematic) amal hai jo ______ ko software products mein badalta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Software development aik systematic amal hai jo user ki zarooraton (user needs) ko software products mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Software development is a systematic process that transforms user needs into software products

blocks.prompt:
2 Understanding the software development process is crucial for creating software solutions that are:
(Software development ke amal ko samajhna kis tarah ke software solutions banane ke liye zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Introduction ke mutabiq yeh amal samajhna reliable (qabil-e-aitmaad), maintainable (sambhalne ke qabil) aur scalable (barhne ke qabil) software ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Understanding the software development process is crucial for creating reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions

blocks.prompt:
3 Software development is the process of:
(Software development kis amal ko kehte hain?)

options.text: assembling the parts of a computer
creating computer programs designed to perform specific tasks

blocks.explanation: Section 1.1: software development computer programs banane ka amal hai jo khaas kaam karte hain; is mein code likhna, test karna aur masail hal karna shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: Software development is the process of creating computer programs designed to perform specific tasks

blocks.prompt:
4 According to the book, which software helps us manage our money?
(Kitab ke mutabiq kaun sa software hamare paise ka intezam karne mein madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.1 ki misalein: dosto se baat ke liye social media, paise ke intezam ke liye banking apps, aur seekhne ko mazedar banane ke liye educational games.

book_ref.quote: helps us manage our money with banking apps

blocks.text: 1.2 Introduction to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

blocks.prompt:
5 The SDLC defines the processes used to build an application from:
(SDLC application banane ke amal ko kahan se kahan tak bayan karta hai?)

options.text: its initial conception to its deployment and maintenance

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2: SDLC aik framework hai jo application ko shuru ke khayal (conception) se le kar deployment aur maintenance tak banane ke amal bayan karta hai.

book_ref.quote: defines the processes used by organizations to build an application from its initial conception to its deployment and maintenance

blocks.prompt:
6 Besides meeting customer expectations, the software delivered through SDLC should:
(Customer ki tawaqqu poori karne ke ilawa SDLC se bana software kaisa hona chahiye?)

options.text: be completed within time and cost estimates and work efficiently

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2: SDLC ka maqsad aisa software hai jo customer ki tawaqqu poori kare, waqt aur kharche ke andaze (estimates) ke andar mukammal ho aur achhi tarah chale.

book_ref.quote: reaches completion within time and cost estimates, and works efficiently

blocks.prompt:
7 In software engineering, a framework is a standardized and reusable set of:
(Software engineering mein framework kin cheezon ka standard aur dobara istemal hone wala majmooa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.1: framework concepts, practices aur tools ka standard aur reusable (dobara istemal hone wala) majmooa hai jo application banane ki buniyad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: a framework is a standardized and reusable set of concepts, practices, and tools

blocks.prompt:
8 Which of the following is NOT a ready-made feature of Django named in the book?
(In mein se kaun si cheez kitab mein Django ki tayyar (ready-made) feature ke taur par nahi likhi?)

options.text: Translating C programs into machine code

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.1: Django mein user login, database management aur page templates tayyar milte hain. C ko machine code mein badalna compiler (jaise GCC) ka kaam hai.

book_ref.quote: Django comes with ready-made features like user login, database management, and page templates

blocks.prompt:
9 Using a framework mainly allows developers to:
(Framework istemal karne se developers ko sab se bara faida kya hota hai?)

options.text: focus on code specific to their application instead of reinventing common solutions

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.1: framework mein pehle se bane hisse hote hain, is liye developer sirf apni application ka khaas code likhta hai, aam hal dobara nahi banata.

book_ref.quote: Frameworks promote efficiency, consistency, and code reusability

blocks.prompt:
10 Which is the correct order of the SDLC stages described in the book?
(Kitab mein bayan SDLC ke marahil (stages) ki sahi tarteeb kaun si hai?)

options.text: Requirement gathering, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, Maintenance
Design, Requirement gathering, Testing, Development, Maintenance, Deployment
Development, Design, Requirement gathering, Deployment, Testing, Maintenance
Requirement gathering, Development, Design, Deployment, Testing, Maintenance

blocks.explanation: Sections 1.2.2.1 se 1.2.2.6 tak stages is tarteeb mein hain: requirement gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance.

book_ref.quote: It is used by software developers and engineers to guide the design, development, and testing of software

blocks.prompt:
11 In which SDLC phase do developers talk to users and stakeholders to find out their needs and expectations?
(SDLC ke kis marhale mein developers users aur stakeholders se un ki zarooratein maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.1: pehle marhale requirement gathering (zarooratein jama karna) mein users aur stakeholders se baat kar ke software ki zarooratein jama ki jati hain.

book_ref.quote: In this initial phase, the goal is to understand and collect what the software needs to achieve

blocks.prompt:
12 Watching how users work with the current system to find problems is the requirement-gathering activity called:
(Users ko maujooda system par kaam karte dekh kar masail dhoondna requirement gathering ki kaun si activity hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.1: observations (mushahida) mein dekha jata hai ke users maujooda system ko kaise chalate hain, taa ke masail aur behtari ke mauqe milein.

book_ref.quote: Watching how users interact with current systems to identify problems and opportunities for improvement

blocks.prompt:
13 Studying existing reports and user manuals to gather more information about requirements is called:
(Maujooda reports aur user manuals parh kar requirements ki mazeed maloomat lena kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.1: document review mein reports aur user manuals jaise maujooda kaghzat dekh kar requirements ki mazeed maloomat li jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Looking at existing documents, such as reports and user manuals

blocks.prompt:
14 The book compares requirement gathering to:
(Kitab requirement gathering ko kis cheez se tashbeeh deti hai?)

options.text: kisi bari taqreeb, jaise shadi, ki planning

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.1: jaise shadi ki tayyari mein dulha dulhan ki pasand jaanni hoti hai, waise hi developers ko users ki khwahish jaanni hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Requirement gathering is similar to planning a big event, like a wedding

blocks.prompt:
15 Requirements that outline the tasks, services and functionalities a system must perform are:
(Woh requirements jo batati hain ke system kaun se kaam, services aur functions karega, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Functional requirements system ke khaas kaam (functions) batati hain, yani system kya karega.

book_ref.quote: Functional requirements describe the specific behaviors or functions of a system

blocks.prompt:
16 'The system should handle up to 1000 simultaneous users without slowing down' is which non-functional requirement?
('System 1000 users ko aik saath bina sust hue chalaye' kaun si non-functional requirement hai?)
blocks.explanation: Library ki misal mein 1000 users aik saath bina sust hue sambhalna performance (karkardagi) ki requirement hai.

book_ref.quote: The system should handle up to 1000 simultaneous users without performance degradation

blocks.prompt:
17 A library system 'should be available 99.9% of the time with minimal downtime'. This is a:
(Library system '99.9% waqt dastyab rahe' - yeh kis qisam ki requirement hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reliability (non-functional): system 99.9% waqt dastyab rahe aur band hone ka waqt (downtime) kam se kam ho.

book_ref.quote: The system should be available 99.9% of the time

blocks.prompt:
18 Which of the following is a FUNCTIONAL requirement of a library management system?
(In mein se library management system ki FUNCTIONAL requirement kaun si hai?)

options.text: Librarians can add, update and remove books from the inventory
The interface should be easy to navigate
The system should scale to more users

blocks.explanation: Inventory management (kitabein shamil, update aur khatam karna) system ka kaam hai, is liye functional hai; baqi teen non-functional hain.

book_ref.quote: Librarians should be able to add, update, and remove books from the inventory

blocks.prompt:
19 Encrypting user data and controlling access through secure authentication is the non-functional requirement of:
(User data ko encrypt karna aur mehfooz authentication se access control karna kaun si non-functional requirement hai?)
blocks.explanation: Security (hifazat): user data encrypt ho aur access mehfooz authentication se control ho.

book_ref.quote: access should be controlled through secure authentication mechanisms

blocks.prompt:
20 According to Table 1.1, which statement is true for functional requirements?
(Table 1.1 ke mutabiq functional requirements ke bare mein kaun si baat durust hai?)

options.text: They define the quality attributes and constraints of the system
They describe how the system should perform
They are directly related to user interactions and system tasks
They are related to usability and reliability

blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: functional requirements user ke amal aur system ke kaamon se seedha juri hain; baqi teen baatein non-functional ki hain.

book_ref.quote: Directly related to user interactions and system tasks

blocks.prompt:
21 The design phase of SDLC is compared in the book to:
(Kitab mein SDLC ke design phase ko kis se tashbeeh di gayi hai?)

options.text: ghar banane se pehle blueprint (naqsha) banana

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.2: design mein software ki shakal aur kaam ka mansooba banta hai, jaise ghar banane se pehle naqsha (blueprint).

book_ref.quote: This is like drawing a blueprint before building a house

blocks.prompt:
22 Creating mockups of the user interface belongs to which design activity?
(User interface ke mockups banana design ki kaun si activity hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.2: Develop Models mein software ka dhancha dikhaya jata hai, jis mein user interface ke mockups bhi shamil ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: This could include creating mockups of the user interface

blocks.prompt:
23 Deciding the overall structure of the software and how its components will interact is called:
(Software ka majmooi dhancha aur us ke hisson ka aapas mein rabta tay karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.2: Plan the Architecture mein software ka poora dhancha aur components ka rabta tay hota hai.

book_ref.quote: To decide the overall structure of the software, including how different components will interact

blocks.prompt:
24 In the design phase, a flowchart is drawn to:
(Design phase mein flowchart kis liye banaya jata hai?)

options.text: install the software on the user's system
map out the steps the program will take to complete a task
merge code into a central repository

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.2: flowchart se woh qadam dikhaye jate hain jo program kaam mukammal karne ke liye uthayega.

book_ref.quote: we draw a flowchart to map out the steps the program will take to complete a task

blocks.prompt:
25 In the development phase, 'code' means:
(Development phase mein 'code' se kya muraad hai?)

options.text: a drawing of the user interface
a set of instructions that the computer follows to perform specific tasks

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.3: code hidayat (instructions) ka majmooa hai jis par computer khaas kaam karne ke liye amal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This is where programmers write the code, which is a set of instructions that the computer follows to perform specific tasks

blocks.prompt:
26 In the book's recipe analogy for the development phase, the design specifications are:
(Development phase ki recipe wali misal mein design specifications kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.3: design specifications recipe hain, aur coding ajza (ingredients) mila kar cake pakane ka amal hai.

book_ref.quote: the design specifications are the recipe, and coding is the process of mixing and baking the ingredients

blocks.prompt:
27 During the development phase, if programmers find issues in their code they:
(Development phase mein agar programmers ko code mein masla mile to woh kya karte hain?)

options.text: revise the code, correct the problems and test again

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.3: masla milne par programmers code durust karte hain aur dobara test karte hain, jab tak software agle marhale ke liye tayyar na ho.

book_ref.quote: If any issues are found, programmers revise the code, correct the problems, and test again

blocks.prompt:
28 The book describes the testing phase of SDLC as a:
(Kitab SDLC ke testing phase ko kya kehti hai?)

options.text: quality check to make sure everything works as expected

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.4: testing mein software ke bugs aur ghaltiyan dhoondi jati hain; yeh aik quality check hai.

book_ref.quote: Think of it as a quality check to make sure everything works as expected

blocks.prompt:
29 Checking whether software works well under high traffic or heavy data is:
(Yeh check karna ke software zyada traffic ya bhaari data mein theek chalta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.4: performance testing dekhti hai ke zyada traffic ya bhaari data mein software theek chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Checking if the software performs well under different conditions, such as high traffic or heavy data

blocks.prompt:
30 Compatibility testing makes sure that the software:
(Compatibility testing kis baat ko yaqeeni banati hai?)

options.text: has all features according to the specifications
works well on various devices and operating systems

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.4: compatibility testing dekhti hai ke software mukhtalif devices aur operating systems par theek chale.

book_ref.quote: Making sure the software works well on various devices and operating systems

blocks.prompt:
31 Making the tested software available for users to access and use is called:
(Test shuda software ko users ke istemal ke liye dastyab karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.5: testing ke baad deployment hoti hai, yani software ko users ke liye dastyab karna.

book_ref.quote: Deployment is the process of making the software available for users to access and use

blocks.prompt:
32 Setting up user preferences, network settings and database connections during deployment is:
(Deployment mein user preferences, network settings aur database connections set karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.5: configuration mein software ko user ya idare ki zaroorat ke mutabiq set kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This can include setting up user preferences, network settings, and database connections

blocks.prompt:
33 During deployment, running a program that copies files onto the user's system or server is part of:
(Deployment mein aisa program chalana jo user ke system ya server par files copy kare, kis step ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.5: installation mein software user ke system ya server par lagaya jata hai, aksar installation program chala kar.

book_ref.quote: running an installation program that copies files and sets up necessary configurations

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is the software tested in its real-world environment after installation?
(Installation ke baad software ko asal mahol mein kyun test kiya jata hai?)

options.text: To write the first version of the code
To ensure it works correctly with other systems and meets user needs
To collect requirements from the users

blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.5: taa ke yaqeen ho ke software doosre systems ke saath theek chalta hai aur users ki zaroorat poori karta hai.

book_ref.quote: After installation, the software is tested in its real-world environment

blocks.prompt:
35 'You need to water it regularly and address any problems to keep it healthy.' This analogy describes which SDLC phase?
('Usay baqaidgi se pani dein aur masail hal karein taa ke sehatmand rahe' - yeh misal SDLC ke kis phase ki hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2.2.6: maintenance paude ki dekh bhaal jaisi hai; musalsal updates se software theek chalta rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Maintenance is like taking care of a plant

blocks.prompt:
36 Structured approaches that guide the planning, creation and management of software projects are called:
(Woh munazzam tareeqe jo software projects ki planning, banane aur intezam ki rehnumai karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3: methodologies (tareeqa-e-kaar) software projects ki planning aur intezam ke munazzam tareeqe hain.

book_ref.quote: Software development methodologies are structured approaches to software development

blocks.prompt:
37 Software process models are:
(Software process models kya hain?)

options.text: lists of bugs found during testing
abstract representations of the processes in the software development lifecycle

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1: process models software lifecycle ke amal ki khayali (abstract) tasveer hain.

book_ref.quote: Software process models are abstract representations of the processes involved in the software development lifecycle

blocks.prompt:
38 Which importance of process models lets teams predict outcomes and manage risks more effectively?
(Process models ki kaun si ahmiyat team ko nataij ka andaza aur risks ka behtar intezam karne deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1: predictability (pehle se andaza); tay shuda amal par chal kar team nataij ka andaza laga sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: By following a defined process, teams can predict outcomes and manage risks more effectively

blocks.prompt:
39 'Structured methodologies streamline the development process, reducing wasted effort.' This describes:
('Munazzam tareeqe kaam ko hamwar kar ke zaya mehnat kam karte hain' - yeh kis ki wazahat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1: efficiency (kaam ki behtari) yani zaya mehnat ko kam karna.

book_ref.quote: Structured methodologies streamline the development process, reducing wasted effort

blocks.prompt:
40 In the Waterfall Model, the phases are carried out:
(Waterfall Model mein phases kis tarah chalte hain?)

options.text: one after another; each phase is completed before the next begins
in any order the team likes

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.1: Waterfall linear aur sequential hai; har phase mukammal hone ke baad agla shuru hota hai, wapas nahi jate.

book_ref.quote: This model is linear and sequential

blocks.prompt:
41 In the Waterfall Model, the actual code is written in the phase called:
(Waterfall Model mein asal code kis phase mein likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.1: Implementation phase mein software banane ka asal code likha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Write the actual code to create the software

blocks.prompt:
42 The Waterfall Model is most suitable for:
(Waterfall Model kis qisam ke project ke liye sab se munasib hai?)

options.text: small projects with clear, fixed requirements
projects needing changes after every sprint

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.1: Waterfall chhote projects ke liye theek hai jin ki requirements wazeh aur pakki hon.

book_ref.quote: Works well for projects with clear, fixed requirements where changes are unlikely

blocks.prompt:
43 Which is a limitation (inflexibility) of the Waterfall Model?
(Waterfall Model ki kaun si khami (inflexibility) hai?)

options.text: It needs two developers at one workstation
Going back to change a completed phase is difficult and costly

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.1: inflexibility (lachak ki kami); mukammal phase mein wapas ja kar tabdeeli mushkil aur mehngi hai.

book_ref.quote: Once a phase is completed, going back to make changes is difficult and costly

blocks.prompt:
44 The 'risk and uncertainty' limitation of the Waterfall Model arises because it assumes that:
(Waterfall Model ki 'risk and uncertainty' wali khami is liye hai ke yeh farz karta hai ke:)

options.text: all requirements are known from the start

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.1: yeh farz karta hai ke saari requirements shuru se maloom hain; baad mein nayi zaroorat aaye to risk hai.

book_ref.quote: The model assumes that all requirements are known from the start

blocks.prompt:
45 Agile Methodology focuses on:
(Agile Methodology kis baat par tawajjo deti hai?)

options.text: completing each phase fully before the next
fixing all requirements at the start
delivering the whole software only once at the end
delivering small, working parts quickly and adapting to changes

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: Agile software ke chhote chalte hisse jaldi deti hai aur tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhal jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Agile focuses on delivering small, functional parts of the software quickly and adapting to changes as the project progresses

blocks.prompt:
46 Writing tests before writing the code is the Agile practice called:
(Code likhne se pehle tests likhna Agile ki kaun si practice hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: Test-Driven Development mein code se pehle tests likhe jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Writing tests before writing the code to ensure the software works as expected

blocks.prompt:
47 In pair programming:
(Pair programming mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: two teams test the same software separately
two developers work at one workstation; one writes code and the other reviews it in real time
one developer writes two programs at once

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: pair programming mein do developers aik computer par kaam karte hain; aik code likhta, doosra usi waqt jaanchta hai.

book_ref.quote: Two developers work together at one workstation

blocks.prompt:
48 Which Agile practice regularly merges code changes into a central repository?
(Agile ki kaun si practice code ki tabdeeliyan baqaidgi se central repository mein milati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: continuous integration mein code ki tabdeeliyan baqaidgi se central repository mein milai jati hain taa ke masail jaldi milein.

book_ref.quote: Regularly merging code changes into a central repository to detect and fix issues early

blocks.prompt:
49 Agile improves customer satisfaction mainly because:
(Agile se customer ki tasalli kyun barhti hai?)

options.text: customers never need to give feedback
the full software is delivered only at the end
requirements are frozen at the start
customers see progress through regular delivery of working software and give feedback

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: baqaidgi se chalta software milne par customer taraqqi dekhta aur feedback deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Regular updates and frequent delivery of working software mean that customers can see progress

blocks.prompt:
50 Which of these is a limitation of Agile Methodology?
(In mein se Agile Methodology ki khami kaun si hai?)

options.text: It assumes all requirements are known from the start
It needs active participation from all stakeholders
Changes are not allowed after development starts
It has no feedback from customers

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: Agile ki khamiyan: bare projects mein mushkil, tamam stakeholders ki shirkat zaroori, aur kam andaza-pazeer hona.

book_ref.quote: Agile requires active participation from all stakeholders

blocks.prompt:
51 Why is it harder to predict the exact timeline and scope of an Agile project?
(Agile project ka theek waqt aur daira (scope) pehle se batana mushkil kyun hai?)

options.text: Because only one developer works on it
Because Agile projects evolve through feedback and changes

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.2: Agile project feedback aur tabdeeli se aage barhta hai, is liye theek waqt aur scope batana mushkil hai.

book_ref.quote: Since Agile projects evolve through feedback and changes

blocks.prompt:
52 Scrum is:
(Scrum kya hai?)

options.text: an agile framework for managing and completing complex software projects

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Scrum aik agile framework hai jo pechida software projects ke intezam ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Scrum is an agile framework widely used for managing and completing complex software projects

blocks.prompt:
53 The Scrum framework is built around:
(Scrum framework kin cheezon par qaim hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Scrum roles (kirdar), events (waqiat) aur artifacts (cheezein) par bana hai.

book_ref.quote: The framework is built around a set of roles, events, and artifacts

blocks.prompt:
54 In Scrum, who defines the product backlog and keeps the team on the highest-priority items?
(Scrum mein product backlog kaun tay karta hai aur team ko sab se ahem kaamon par rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Product Owner product backlog banata hai aur team ko sab se ahem kaam par rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Product Owner defines the product backlog and ensures that the team is working on the highest-priority items

blocks.prompt:
55 Who is responsible for delivering the product increments in Scrum?
(Scrum mein product increments dene ki zimmedari kis ki hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Development Team (mukhtalif mahir afraad) product increments dene ki zimmedar hai.

book_ref.quote: The Development Team, consisting of cross-functional members, is responsible for delivering the product increments

blocks.prompt:
56 In Scrum, time-boxed iterations are called:
(Scrum mein muqarrara waqt wali iterations ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Sprints muqarrara waqt (time-boxed) ki iterations hain.

book_ref.quote: These include Sprints (time-boxed iterations)

blocks.prompt:
57 Which of the following is NOT a Scrum event?
(In mein se kaun sa Scrum event NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Product Backlog aik artifact hai, event nahi; baqi teen events hain.

book_ref.quote: Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint Retrospectives

blocks.prompt:
58 In Scrum, the working product that results from the current Sprint is the:
(Scrum mein maujooda Sprint ke nateeje mein bana chalta product kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Increment woh chalta product hai jo maujooda Sprint ka nateeja hai.

book_ref.quote: Increment (the working product that is the result of the current Sprint)

blocks.prompt:
59 A list of tasks to be completed in one Sprint is the:
(Aik Sprint mein mukammal hone wale kaamon ki fehrist kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Sprint Backlog aik Sprint ke kaamon ki fehrist hai; Product Backlog tamam features ki tarjeehi fehrist hai.

book_ref.quote: Sprint Backlog (a list of tasks to be completed in a Sprint)

blocks.prompt:
60 Which kind of project does the book name as suitable for Scrum?
(Kitab ke mutabiq kaun sa project Scrum ke liye munasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Scrum mobile apps aur web development ke liye munasib hai; embedded aur safety-critical software ke liye nahi.

book_ref.quote: Mobile app development often involves continuous feedback and rapid iterations

blocks.prompt:
61 Lean Software Development is derived from:
(Lean Software Development kahan se liya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3.1.3: Lean Software Development Lean manufacturing ke usoolon se liya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Derived from Lean manufacturing principles

blocks.prompt:
62 The Lean principle that removes activities which add no value to the customer is:
(Lean ka kaun sa usool woh kaam khatam karta hai jo customer ke liye faida mand nahi?)
